# Greenland turbot 2026 projections

Code

Input audit and conditional projection results

Rendered

October 27, 2026

This working report audits the current input files and, when explicitly
selected, reads a completed projection attempt. Rendering **never
compiles or runs ADMB**. Conditional projections describe the supplied
inputs and assumptions; they are not adopted catch recommendations.

## Run controls

From this directory, render the current input audit with:

``` bash
quarto render greenland_turbot.qmd
```

The default selects no saved attempt, so this command works in a fresh
source checkout and produces the audit without projection figures or
tables.

To include results, set `saved_run` in the YAML above or pass the actual
attempt directory explicitly. This example path is illustrative; the
report never selects the newest directory automatically:

``` bash
quarto render greenland_turbot.qmd -P saved_run:spmR_runs/attempt-001
```

``` r
saved_run <- params$saved_run
worms_per_plot <- 15L
table_years <- 3L
```

### Start a new projection manually

Run this chunk yourself in R **after reviewing the input audit**. It is
excluded from rendering. Keep `run_new_projections = FALSE` until the
histories are complete. Supply verified population weights, units and
ages, or explicitly choose the diagnostic assumptions with
`use_diagnostic_weights = TRUE`. Diagnostic mode cannot repair missing
history values. Work from `examples/gt_2026` in R.

``` r
source("run.R")
run_new_projections <- FALSE
use_diagnostic_weights <- FALSE
population_weights <- NULL
units <- NULL
ages <- NULL

if (run_new_projections) {
  projection <- run_gt2026_projection(
    diagnostic = use_diagnostic_weights,
    population_weights = population_weights,
    units = units,
    ages = ages
  )
  projection$run_dir
}
```

After a successful run, use the returned directory as `saved_run` and
render again. Each new run receives a separate attempt directory.
Re-rendering reads saved outputs and preserves the attempt contents.

## Current status

**Saved conditional projection loaded.** No new projection was run.

Current recruitment and SSB lengths agree. Their calendar pairing and
scientific declarations still require review.

Diagnostic population weights are fleet-weighted catch-weight proxies,
not verified population body weights. SS3 export definitions, units, age
order, plus group, initial abundance timing and spawning-weight/maturity
definitions remain scientific review items. The audit below refers to
**current files**; saved-run assumptions are displayed separately in the
provenance section.

## Input audit

The current controls request 1000 simulations across 7 alternatives for
15 years, beginning in 2026.

| Input | Status | Finding |
|----|----|----|
| Native metadata | info | A separate spm_input_v2.dat is optional; the runner embeds validated declarations in the staged species file. |
| R metadata | info | A separate spm_metadata.json is optional. Existing files are archived; staged declarations come from explicit arguments or diagnostic defaults. |
| Recruitment rows | repair | 2 copies of a 47 value series across 2 lines; retain one complete series. A second copy would be read as SSB. |
| Recruitment basis | ok | Source explicitly declares per_sex recruitment. |
| Spawning weights | repair | 4 zeros in effective spawning weights; stage them as 1e-12 for the current positive-weight contract. |
| Population weights | missing | Population body weights require explicit runner arguments and SS3 verification. Diagnostic defaults use Fratio-weighted catch-weight proxies, with fleet fractions 0.96, 0.04 |
| Units and ages | review | Thousand fish, kg, tonnes and ages 1:30/30+ are working assumptions requiring SS3 export verification. |
| SSB history | review | 47 positions; source label: \# SSB 1978-2026 . Calendar pairing remains unresolved; restrict to Tier 3, Rec_Gen=1. The final two SSB values repeat the preceding pair; confirm this with the source export. |
| Maturity fields | info | All-one maturity retains effective spawning weights. Ntot and SexRatio describe all fish and the all-fish female fraction. Confirm the SS3 spawning-weight definition. |
| Controls | ok | 2026-2040; 7 alternatives; 1000 simulations. Adapter requires Tier 3, Rec_Gen=1, TAC_ABC=1, beginning year 2026 and ForProjections.dat. |
| TAC parameters | info | tacpar.dat is archived when supplied and unused with TAC_ABC=1. |

Table 1: Current GT2026 input checks. Repair and review entries remain
visible even when a saved run is selected.

## Projection plots

Each panel represents one alternative. The **same 15 simulations**,
selected deterministically by their sorted simulation IDs, appear as
thin blue lines (“worms”) in every plot. The black line is the median
across **all** simulations; the grey band spans their 5th–95th
percentiles, a **90% projection interval**. The 15 paths illustrate
simulations rather than estimating the full uncertainty by themselves.
Fixed catches can cause several paths to overlap exactly.

## Provenance and checks

The report requires a successful native exit and verifies recorded
input, output and archived-source hashes before displaying a saved run.
It checks result dimensions, alternative/year/simulation keys and finite
nonnegative quantities. Current-source differences are labelled rather
than overwritten. Historical-recruitment simulation fits no parameters:
maximum-gradient and positive-definite-Hessian diagnostics are **not
applicable** in this mode.
